name: Vampire's Kiss: Time Paradox
source:
Vampire's Kiss: Time Paradox – is a romantic anime novel about vampires and the distortion of time. Your choices will determine the fate of the heroine and her chosen one. Meet mysterious guys, uncover secrets, and find your unique ending!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4207160/Vampires_Kiss_Time_Paradox/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《吸血鬼之吻：时间悖论》是一部关于吸血鬼和时间扭曲的浪漫动漫小说。你的选择将决定女主角和她所选择的人的命运。结识神秘人物，揭开秘密，找到属于你的独特结局！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4207160/Vampires_Kiss_Time_Paradox/]Steam[/url]]
